# ConnectLog

ConnectLog is a production relationship command OS for QR contact exchange, Relay13 owned messaging, vCard handoff, relationship memory, follow-up discipline, bulk contact import, seed pack ingestion, duplicate resolution, and portable exports.

Primary surfaces:
- Landing page: /index.html
- App workspace: /app.html

Data posture:
- Runs on the production 0S Worker route.
- Uses IndexedDB for operator-side relationship vault resilience.
- Uses Relay13 for owned messaging when operator credentials are configured.
- Supports JSON, CSV, vCard, and agenda exports.
